issues.note: Crushing or flattening by pressure (smash garlic, smashed finger) is common and uncovered.
Bare "ring" is ambiguous for learners; "smash a drug ring" is the typical form.
Wording "is beaten" is awkward, but it does gesture at the record sense.
Crash fact repeated in compare note and synonym discrimination; one fact, one field.

findings.F1: Missing the common crush or flatten sense (smash garlic, smash a finger in a door).
findings.F2: Collocation "smash a ring" is unclear without a modifier such as drug or crime.
findings.F3: The fact that crash is the usual vehicle word is stated in two fields.
